AcquisitionUse.description: How the source was fetched. Names and counts only; never proxy URLs or credentials.
AcquisitionUse.title: AcquisitionUse

BlockedHint.description: A site refused access; ``docs`` is a repository-relative guide anchor.
BlockedHint.title: BlockedHint

CrawlNote.description: The state of a crawl when it ended, including its checkpoint.
CrawlNote.title: CrawlNote

CssRecipe.description: Select HTML records with ``record_selector``; fields end in ::text or ::attr(name).
CssRecipe.title: CssRecipe

DiscoveryNote.description: Where the source's pages came from and how many locations survived filtering.
DiscoveryNote.title: DiscoveryNote

EmbeddedJsonRecipe.description:
Read JSON embedded in HTML: ``source`` selects one node, then ``record_path`` and fields
work as in ``JsonRecipe``.

``source`` is a CSS selector ending in ``::attr(name)`` (``input[name=GXState]::attr(value)``)
or ``::text`` (``script#__NEXT_DATA__::text``); it must match exactly one node.
EmbeddedJsonRecipe.title: EmbeddedJsonRecipe

Issue.description:
Safe diagnostics: no input values or user-supplied validation messages.

``message`` names Pydantic's error type and message (for example
``int_parsing: Input should be a valid integer``) only for built-in types whose
message cannot contain input (see ``domain.safe_messages``); custom validator
text is never included. It is omitted from serialized output when absent.
Issue.title: Issue

JobRecordData.description: Open object shape representing dynamically validated record payloads in JSON Schema.
JobRecordData.title: JobRecordData

JobSummary.description: Aggregate execution metadata across all sources in one job run.
JobSummary.title: JobSummary

JsonLdRecipe.description:
Map JSON-LD objects, optionally of one or several ``item_type`` values, with pointers.

``item_type`` is one type or 1..8 types; an object matches when any of its ``@type``
values is listed. A field maps to one pointer or to 1..4 pointers; the first that
resolves wins.
JsonLdRecipe.title: JsonLdRecipe

JsonRecipe.description: Select JSON records at ``record_path``; fields are pointers relative to each record.
JsonRecipe.title: JsonRecipe

LadderStep.description: One attempt at one ladder level and how it ended.
LadderStep.title: LadderStep

NestedMapping.description: Select items, then read either scalar values or named scalar members.

each.description: Relative CSS scope selector or absolute JSON pointer with one wildcard segment.
each.title: Each

members.description: Named scalar expressions relative to each item; excludes value.
members.title: Members

value.description: One scalar expression relative to each item; excludes members.
value.title: Value

NestedMapping.title: NestedMapping

Pagination.description: A bounded next-page expression, interpreted by the recipe strategy.
Pagination.title: Pagination

RecipeSelection.description:
Which recipe one job source used: the job file's, or the serving one in recipe memory.

``memory`` covers a stored serving recipe newer than the job file's, a pinned
``recipe_version``, and sources without a recipe in the job file (memory lookup or
learning). ``recipe_version`` is ``None`` only when no recipe existed before the run.
RecipeSelection.title: RecipeSelection

RepairNote.description: Drift and repair for the source; ``promotion_refused`` is an issue code.
RepairNote.title: RepairNote

RepairProposal.description: One stored repair candidate and the gate decision recipe CI gave it.
RepairProposal.title: RepairProposal

RunReport.description: A content-free report of one ``run`` or ``load`` of one job file.
RunReport.title: RunReport

RunTotals.description: Totals across every source of the run.
RunTotals.title: RunTotals

SelfRepair.description:
What offline self-repair did after a remembered recipe stopped matching.

``promoted`` is true only when a candidate passed every gate, became the serving
recipe and produced this result. ``candidates`` lists every stored proposal.
With a model, ``origin`` says whether candidates came from relocation or the model
and ``model_calls`` counts its proposal and judge calls.
SelfRepair.title: SelfRepair

SourceNotes.description: Every note about one source. Empty attributes are left out when serialized.
SourceNotes.title: SourceNotes

SourceReport.description: One source: where (host and path, never a query), how it ended and what it produced.
SourceReport.title: SourceReport

SourceTiming.description: Wall-clock seconds spent per stage for one source.
SourceTiming.title: SourceTiming

SpiderPage.description: One discovered URL and what became of it: host and path only, never a query.
SpiderPage.title: SpiderPage

SpiderReport.description: Every attempted page in discovery order, capped; ``unreported`` counts the rest.
SpiderReport.title: SpiderReport
